posts.name: Saurav I R
posts.cooked:
Dear IITM Support Team,
I am writing to bring to your urgent attention a clash between my university semester exams and the upcoming OPPE 2 exams for the F1-2026 term.
My details are as follows:
Name: Chinmay Kumar Swarnkar
Roll Number: 23F3004384
Co urses: System Commands (SE2001) & Database Management Systems (BSCS2001)
My regular B.Ed Semester 1 university examinations are scheduled on the 23rd, 25th, and 27th of April 2026. My university exam center is approximately 60 km away.
Specifically, on April 25, my university exam is from 02:00 PM to 04:00 PM. It is physically impossible for me to travel 60 km right after this exam to attend the System Commands OPPE 2, which is scheduled from 06:00 PM to 08:00 PM on the same day. Because of my continuous university exams, I am also unable to attend the DBMS OPPE 2 on April 26.
Therefore, I earnestly request you to reschedule my OPPE 2 for both SE2001 and BSCS2001 to the May 2026 backup slots.
Additionally, my portal shows the ‘Overall_Eligible’ status for the System Commands (SE2001) OPPE 2 as “In_Eligible”, even though I meet the ‘5 out of 7’ and ‘GrPA’ criteria. I request you to kindly look into this discrepancy and resolve it.
I have attached my B.Ed admit card and screenshots of the IITM portal showing the clash and the eligibility status for your verification.
Looking forward to your swift assistance.

Sincerely,

Chinmay Kumar Swarnkar

Roll Number: 23F3004384 @AtulPS @Manidipa2001

Screenshot 2026-04-22 161027992×704 114 KB
